item.title: INDIA Bloc floor leaders’ meeting concludes at Mallikarjun Kharge’s office in Parliament
item.description: NEW DELHI: A meeting of floor leaders of the INDIA bloc was held on Tuesday at the office of the Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha and Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge in the Parliament House complex. item.description: NEW DELHI: Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju on Tuesday backed the complaint filed by BJP women MPs with Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, alleging that Congress MPs crossed parliamentary limits. item.title: “Either General Naravane or publisher is lying”: Rahul Gandhi claims ‘Four Stars of Destiny was available online’
item.description: NEW DELHI: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, on Tuesday accused the publisher of ‘Four Stars of Destiny’, a memoir by former Indian Army Chief General MM Naravane, of lying, claiming that the book was available for sale. item.title: Congress to submit no-confidence motion against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla: Sources
item.description: NEW DELHI: After days of adjournments and ruckus in the Lower House, the Congress party will shortly submit a no-confidence motion against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla. item.description: NEW DELHI: The Lok Sabha was adjourned again on Tuesday till 2 pm after Opposition MPs staged a protest at the Well of the House. item.description: JAMMU: Dr Ranjeet Singh Kotwal (JKAS), a 2011-batch officer currently serving as Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Chenani, has been unanimously elected as the Interim President of the All Jammu & Kashmir Junior Scale JKAS Association.
